_about: Length guidance used by scripts/audit.py. None of these is a rule a search engine publishes; they are working values for when a result is likely to be cut or rewritten. Every value was written from memory and is unverified. A finding built on them is a warning, never a failure.

title_min_chars.source: mstack working value: shorter titles rarely name both the page and the site. Not from a published standard.

title_max_chars.source: Common guidance for when a result title is cut. Search engines cut by pixel width, not by a character count; see Google Search Central, 'Influencing your title links'.

description_min_chars.source: mstack working value. Not from a published standard.

description_max_chars.source: Common guidance for when a result snippet is cut. Google states no length limit; see Google Search Central, 'Control your snippets in search results'.
